title: Algebraization of the pullback to a Chow modification
statement: Let A be a commutative Noetherian I-adically complete ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let f:Z -> Spec A be separated and of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with Z Noetherian and nonempty. Let Q=I O_Z and G in Coh(Z,Q) [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] have first support proper over A [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. There exist Y, a proper morphism q:Y -> Z, a quasi-coherent ideal L on Z, and a coherent module F on Y [pqf-def-coherent], such that Z minus V(L) is nonempty, q is an isomorphism after base change to this open, the inverse system q^*G is isomorphic to the completion of F for Q O_Y, and q_*F has support proper over A.

source.place: Theorem 088E, paragraphs 2--4 (closed quotient, Chow modification, projective algebraization and proper push-pull comparison); verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/088E

proof.text: Apply Chow's lemma to Z over Spec A. Its modification q:Y -> Z is proper, isomorphic over a nonempty dense open U, and has an immersion e into a finite projective space. Y is quasi-compact and the projective space is quasi-separated, so e is quasi-compact. The scheme-theoretic image Y'=e.image has a closed inclusion e.imageι into the projective space and e.toImage:Y -> Y' is an open immersion. This directly supplies the projective compactification, without applying the affine-only ProperClosedModel theorem to Y.

Take the reduced ideal L of the complement of the dense open U. Because Z is nonempty and U is dense, U is nonempty. The complement of L.support is U, and the restriction isomorphism of the Chow modification is the base-change isomorphism required here. Properness of q over Noetherian Z makes Y Noetherian.

Pull the formal module to Y. Nakayama on V(I) identifies each term support with the first support, and tensor pullback gives its inverse image under q. This support is proper over A; its image in the separated Y' is closed. Extension by zero to Y' is coherent and satisfies the formal quotient conditions on the open cover by Y and the complement of that closed support. Projective existence algebraizes the extended system. Its algebraization has support inside Y: a nonempty closed support outside Y has nonempty closed image in Spec A under the proper projection, so meets V(I) since I lies in the Jacobson radical. Reduction modulo I and Nakayama identify that intersection with the first support, already inside Y, a contradiction. Restrict the algebraization to Y; completion agrees with the pulled system.

Let F be the restriction of the projective algebraization to Y. The preceding completion comparison is exactly beta:q^*G ~= F^wedge. Its support is proper over A, since its closed immersion into the projective compactification is supported inside Y. The support of q_*F is contained in the closed image of this proper support. Proper coherent pushforward makes that support closed, and the closed-subset and image properness properties make it proper over A.

theorem exists_chowPullbackAlgebraization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (Q : Z.IdealSheafData)
    (hQ : Q = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Z Q)
    (hR : Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.obj.obj (op 0)))
    (hZ : Nonempty Z) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y ⟶ Z) (_ : IsProper q) (L : Z.IdealSheafData)
      (F : CoherentModules Y),
      (L.support.compl : Set Z).Nonempty ∧
      IsIso (pullback.snd q (Scheme.Opens.ι L.support.compl)) ∧
      Nonempty (G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q ≅
        formalCompletionSystem (Q.comap q) F.obj) ∧
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).obj F.obj)
